# OrganicGlobe International

> OrganicGlobe International is a Maharashtra, India-based organic produce export company founded by Avinash Chavan, supplying certified chemical-free fruits, vegetables, jaggery, and cold-pressed oils directly from Indian farmers to international buyers worldwide.

## About

OrganicGlobe International was established in 2023 by founder Avinash Chavan with a mission to bridge Indian organic farmers directly with global buyers — eliminating middlemen, ensuring fair farmer income, and delivering traceable, chemical-free produce to international markets.

The company is headquartered in Maharashtra, India, and exports worldwide.

## Products

OrganicGlobe International specialises in the following organic product categories:

- **Jaggery Products** — traditional cane jaggery and jaggery-based products
- **Wooden Cold-Pressed Oils** — groundnut, sesame, coconut, mustard, sunflower oils extracted using traditional wooden cold-press (ghani) method
- **Cold-Pressed Oils** — groundnut, sesame, coconut, mustard, flaxseed, sunflower, almond, walnut oils
- **Spices** — a wide range of Indian spices, whole and ground
- **Fresh Fruits** — mangoes, bananas, pomegranates, and other seasonal Indian fruits
- **Fresh Vegetables** — tomatoes, onions, potatoes, leafy greens, and more
- **Pulses & Lentils** — toor dal, chana dal, moong dal, urad dal, and other varieties
- **Moringa Products** — moringa powder, moringa leaves, moringa seeds
- **Dry Fruits & Nuts** — cashews, almonds, walnuts, raisins, and more
- **Grains & Cereals** — wheat, rice, millets, sorghum, and other traditional grains

## Export Markets

OrganicGlobe International exports to buyers across multiple continents. Origin country: India (Maharashtra).

## Founder

**Avinash Chavan** — Founder & Director, OrganicGlobe International. Based in Maharashtra, India. Passionate about sustainable agriculture, farmer welfare, and connecting Indian organic produce with global markets.
